description: Import settings from a flat { csm_name: value } map (the seo_export_settings shape). Only csm_* keys are written; secrets (csm_indexnow_key, csm_gsc_service_account, csm_github_token) are never imported. Returns the number of options written.

data.description: Flat map of csm_* option names to values, e.g. { csm_title_separator: '|' }

name: seo_import_settings
